text:
mira: Heads-up — planning to deprecate score_v1 in the reranking response payload on 2026-05-15. We want to switch clients to normalized_score + provenance. Need agreement on: console warnings, rollback/switchback behavior when a model is swapped, and quota/telemetry mapping.

alex: +1 to normalized_score. Quick question: are we keeping raw_logit anywhere for advanced customers?

mira: thinking we drop raw_logit from default envelope but keep it behind a tenant opt-in flag for Dedicated/Private. default public API won't return it.

jon: important: when we flip the default model (eg cost/latency fallback), clients should be able to detect model changes and opt for graceful switchback. How do we signal that in the response?

sophie: propose a model_signature field and a monotonic model_generation id. then clients can do: if model_gen changes -> re-eval last N prompts. quick example: 
```json
{
  "normalized_score": 0.87,
  "confidence_bucket": "high",
  "model_id": "rwd-llama-13b-q4",
  "model_generation": 42,
  "provenance": "ensemble-v2"
}
```

mira: +1. console should surface model_generation per route and show drift alerts when generation changes unexpectedly. UX: toast? notification?

alex: telemetry-wise we need stable metric names. We should map old score_v1 -> normalized_score via a server-side shim for 30 days and emit a compat metric: rerank.score_v1_compat_count. After 30d we stop the shim.

sam-oncall: on the switchback policy — if a higher-latency but higher-quality model is auto-swapped out for a cheaper one due to capacity, we should emit a route-level event and optionally trigger an automatic canary rollback if user-specified threshold breaches (e.g., degraded P95 latency or relevance drop). Otherwise clients will see silent QoS changes.

jon: agree. Also add a graceful flag in the response: "is_fallback": true/false. clients can special-case fallback logic.

sophie: downside: exposing is_fallback lets users hardcode behavior that might block useful degradation. maybe default to telemetry-only and make is_fallback opt-in per tenant.

mira: compromise: show is_fallback in console and in response only when tenant opts into visibility. Always include model_generation and model_id.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: api-shim/score-compat v2 -> staging at 2026-04-10T02:00Z :rocket:

alex: rollout plan: 
- day 0: feature flag on (compat shim + compat metric)
- day 7: console banner + docs update + email to active tenants
- day 14: start returning normalized_score for new traffic (opt-in header X-RWD-SCORE-V2)
- day 30: soft deprecate score_v1 (return normalized_score by default, still accept old clients)
- day 60: remove score_v1 parsing and stop compat metric

sam-oncall: add SLO bump window for 24h after each model rotation and alert if switchbacks > 3 in 1h.

mira: documentation snippets: include sample mapping and migration checklist, e.g., 1) check console model_generation 2) add X-RWD-SCORE-V2 header 3) verify telemetry mapping 4) enable opt-in raw_logit only if needed.

jon: one more: billing/quotas. normalized_score is per-candidate same as before but provenance adds bytes to response. we should account for slightly larger token/byte billing for compatibility period. ops will need an estimate.

sophie: console should show per-route sample payload size and projected cost delta when toggling provenance/raw_logit. small toggle in route settings would be nice. :eyes:

mira: agreed. next steps: alex to draft rollout playbook + compat metric names, jon to spec model_generation and is_fallback semantics, sophie to mock console banner and payload-size UI, sam to add oncall thresholds. I'll consolidate and schedule a quick sync on Tue.

alex: I'll drop the playbook in #eng-platform RFC later today.

mira: thanks everyone :+1:

sam-oncall: ping if you want me to add any PagerDuty notes for the rollout window.
